name: Stormbringer Air Elemental closes to melee when the action bar turns Windpelt off (#12871)
contract: #12871 follow-up: the Air Elemental's chase range comes from Windpelt 806016 autocast, and the chase is
reissued whenever that autocast changes. Autocast changes reach the pet through two client paths:
the pet action bar. This scenario drives the action bar path. The target stands 20 yards from the stationary
Stormbringer, inside Windpelt's 30-yard range: with Windpelt on autocast the pet casts it while staying
within 6 yards of its owner. Turning Windpelt off through CMSG_PET_SET_ACTION mid-fight must reissue the
